method: Read-only exact source review and independently replayed retained author-built LLVM API harness; no reviewer rebuild. Embedded C host is bound by the exact Rust source.
review: Preflight requires exact integer expected/desired types, pointer operand, natural alignment and {integer,i1} result; call attributes reject. Actual operand inventory includes expected, desired and pointer.

The chosen C11 subset uses an explicit success/failure matrix, not ordinal order strength. All25 pairs are covered in both collecting and validation-only paths;16 invalid pairs reject before LLVM construction.

Native API sets process scope and strong cmpxchg explicitly. Text uses corresponding strong process-scope syntax. All9 admitted pairs test old-value success/failure and four actual pthreads contend through generated CAS in API/text O0/O2.

The added task_abi_identity arm accounts expected argument, result type, desired and pointer in source, but combined backend compilation/exact budget evidence was not available at this checkpoint and is not accepted by this review.
limits: Machine-only evidence: no source operation, public Typed/Wire opcode, independent shared-address kernel admission or general Atomic/Mutex capability follows.
Only i32 native execution is evidenced; other natural integer widths have preflight support only. No native Windows or product/Rust performance claim.
